summary:
Implemented the next no-schema Garage staging slice.

Changed Counter Mode in `garage.html#maintenance-note-preview` so the iPhone next-item card is sticky and now has `Copy Next Item` alongside `Mark Next Staged`, `Copy Buy List`, `Undo Last`, and `Exit Counter Mode`. Search metadata now covers copy-next counter queries, and the service worker cache is bumped to `ridgeline-console-v303`.

Verified:
- `Invoke-BrowserSmoke.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html')` passed
- `Test-InternalLinks.ps1` passed for 16 HTML files
- `Invoke-SiteAudit.ps1 -Pages @('garage.html','maintenance.html') -Tag audit-v303-counter-copy-next -SkipScreenshots` passed
- Captured iPhone screenshot: `debug-screenshots/audit-v303-counter-copy-next-mobile-garage.png`

Updated Anton state/backlog/roadmap/audit notes and added a durable Anton rule for sticky, item-level parts-counter actions.

Impact Score: 4/5
Visible Change: Garage Counter Mode now keeps the current parts-counter item and actions sticky on iPhone, with a new Copy Next Item button.
Impact Reason: This makes the store-counter workflow faster and less error-prone because the user can copy or mark one item at a time without losing the active item while scrolling.
